title: The $1.5B Bybit heist
description: How $1.5B in crypto left Bybit, split into thousands of wallets and was pinned on North Korea.

shots.title: Hook: breaking, $1.5B gone
shots.say: Breaking: 1.5 billion dollars in crypto, gone in a single hack.

shots.title: The cold wallet drains
shots.say: One transfer emptied Bybit's cold wallet. About 401,000 ether, on the move.

shots.title: The biggest ever
shots.say: That makes it the biggest crypto theft ever, more than twice the old record.

shots.title: Split, swapped into bitcoin
shots.say: The thieves split it across thousands of addresses, and swapped some of it into bitcoin.

shots.title: FBI names North Korea
shots.say: Five days later, the FBI said who was behind it: North Korea.

shots.title: End card: the timeline
shots.say: From hack to attribution: five days.
